value.reason: White Horse defeat offset by driving off Song emperor

label.en: co-director of the Secretariat / co-chancellor under the Gate
Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs
co-director of the Department of State Affairs / co-chancellor under the Gate

units.zh: 景宗下九年春正月丙寅，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, on bingyin day of the first spring month, the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: Jingzong, Part Two. In the ninth year, spring, first month, on bingyin day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 二月庚子，宋遣使致其先帝遺物。
units.en: On gengzi day in the second month Song sent envoys bearing relics of their deceased emperor.
units.literal: In the second month, on gengzi day, Song sent envoys presenting relics of their late emperor.

units.zh: 甲寅，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On jiayin day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On jiayin day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 三月癸亥，耶律沙、敵烈獻援漢之役所獲宋俘。
units.en: On guihai day in the third month Yelü Sha and Delie presented Song prisoners captured during the expedition to aid Han.
units.literal: In the third month, on guihai day, Yelü Sha and Delie presented Song captives taken in the campaign to aid Han.

units.zh: 戊辰，詔以粟二十萬斛助漢。
units.en: On wuchen day an edict ordered two hundred thousand hu of grain sent to aid Han.
units.literal: On wuchen day, an edict granted Han two hundred thousand hu of grain as aid.

units.zh: 夏五月庚午，漢遣使來謝，且以宋事來告。
units.en: On gengwu day in the fifth summer month Han sent envoys to offer thanks and to report developments with Song.
units.literal: In summer, fifth month, on gengwu day, Han sent envoys to give thanks and also to report Song affairs.

units.zh: 己丑，女直二十一人來請宰相、夷離堇之職，以次授之。
units.en: On jichou day twenty-one Jurchen petitioned for chancellor and yilijin offices and were appointed in turn according to rank.
units.literal: On jichou day, twenty-one Jurchen came requesting chancellor and yilijin posts; they were granted in order of precedence.

units.zh: 六月丙辰，以宋王喜隱為西南面招討使。
units.en: On bingchen day in the sixth month Prince of Song Xiyin was appointed Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen day, Prince of Song Xiyin was made Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 秋七月庚申朔，回鶻遣使來貢。
units.en: On the gengshen new moon of the seventh autumn month the Uighurs sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengshen day the new moon, Uighur sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 甲子，宋遣使來聘。
units.en: On jiazi day Song dispatched envoys on a diplomatic visit.
units.literal: On jiazi day, Song sent envoys on a visit.

units.zh: 壬申，漢以宋侵來告。
units.en: On renshen day Han sent word that Song had launched an incursion.
units.literal: On renshen day, Han reported that Song had invaded.

units.zh: 丙子，遣使助漢戰馬。
units.en: On bingzi day the court sent envoys with war horses to reinforce Han.
units.literal: On bingzi day, envoys were dispatched with war horses to aid Han.

units.zh: 八月，漢遣使進葡萄酒。
units.en: In the eighth month Han sent envoys presenting grape wine as tribute.
units.literal: In the eighth month, Han sent envoys presenting grape wine.

units.zh: 冬十月甲子，耶律沙以党項降酋可醜、買友來見，賜詔撫諭。
units.en: On jiazi day in the tenth winter month Yelü Sha presented the surrendering Tangut chiefs Kechou and Maiyou at court and received an edict of reassurance and instruction for them.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on jiazi day, Yelü Sha brought Tangut surrendering chiefs Kechou and Maiyou to audience; an edict was granted to comfort and instruct them.

units.zh: 丁卯，以可醜為司徒，買友為太保，各賜物遣之。
units.en: On dingmao day Kechou was appointed Minister of Education and Maiyou Grand Guardian; each received gifts and was dismissed.
units.literal: On dingmao day, Kechou was made Minister of Education and Maiyou Grand Guardian; each was given gifts and sent away.

units.zh: 壬申，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On renshen day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On renshen day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 乙酉，漢復遣使以宋事來告。
units.en: On yiyou day Han again dispatched envoys to report on Song.
units.literal: On yiyou day, Han again sent envoys reporting Song affairs.

units.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，司天奏日當食不虧。
units.en: On the dinghai new moon of the eleventh month the Directorate of Astronomy reported that a solar eclipse was due but the sun showed no obscuration.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on dinghai day the new moon, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the sun ought to be eclipsed but was not obscured.

units.zh: 戊戌，吐谷渾叛入太原者四百餘戶，索而還之。
units.en: On wuxu day more than four hundred Tuyuhun households that had rebelled and fled into Taiyuan were tracked down and sent back.
units.literal: On wuxu day, more than four hundred households of Tuyuhun who had rebelled and entered Taiyuan were sought out and returned.

units.zh: 癸卯，祠木葉山。
units.en: On guimao day the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
units.literal: On guimao day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 乙巳，遣太保叠烈割等使宋。
units.en: On yisi day Grand Guardian Dielege and others were sent as envoys to Song.
units.literal: On yisi day, Grand Guardian Dielege and others were dispatched as envoys to Song.

units.zh: 乙卯，漢復遣使以宋事來告。
units.en: On yimao day Han once more sent envoys reporting developments with Song.
units.literal: On yimao day, Han again sent envoys reporting Song affairs.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，獵於近郊，以所獲祭天。
units.en: On wuchen day in the twelfth month the Emperor hunted near the capital and offered the game in sacrifice to heaven.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuchen day, he hunted in the near suburbs and sacrificed the catch to heaven.

units.zh: 鵩十年春正月癸丑，如長濼。
units.en: In the tenth year, on guichou day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.
units.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on guichou day, he went to Chang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月庚午，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。
units.en: On gengwu day in the second month the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.
units.literal: In the second month, on gengwu day, Asalan Uighur came with tribute.

units.zh: 三月庚寅，祭顯陵。
units.en: On gengyin day in the third month the court sacrificed at Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the third month, on gengyin day, sacrifice was performed at Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 夏四月丁卯，西幸。
units.en: On dingmao day in the fourth summer month the Emperor traveled west.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingmao day, he traveled west.

units.zh: 己巳，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On jisi day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On jisi day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 五月癸卯，賜女裏死，遣人誅高勛等。
units.en: On guimao day in the fifth month Nüli was put to death and agents were sent to execute Gao Xun and his associates.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao day, Nüli was granted death; men were dispatched to execute Gao Xun and others.

units.zh: 六月己未，駐蹕沿柳湖。
units.en: On jiwei day in the sixth month the court made camp at Willow Lake.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiwei day, the court halted at Willow Lake.

units.zh: 秋七月庚戌，享太祖廟。
units.en: On gengxu day in the seventh autumn month the court offered sacrifice at Taizu Temple.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengxu day, sacrifice was offered at Taizu Temple.

units.zh: 九月癸未朔，平王隆先子陳哥謀害其父，車裂以徇。
units.en: On the guiwei new moon of the ninth month Chenge, son of Prince of Ping Longxian, plotted to murder his father and was torn apart by carts as a public warning.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on guiwei day the new moon, Prince of Ping Longxian's son Chenge plotted to kill his father; he was dismembered by cart and displayed.

units.zh: 是冬，駐蹕金川。
units.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.
units.literal: That winter, the court encamped at Jinchuan.

units.zh: 鵩乾亨元年春正月乙酉，遣撻馬長壽使宋，問興師伐劉繼元之故。
units.en: In the first year of Qianheng, on yiyou day of the first spring month, tamasa Changshou was sent to Song to demand an explanation for mobilizing against Liu Jiyuan.
units.literal: In the first year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on yiyou day, tamasa Changshou was dispatched as envoy to Song to ask the reason for raising troops against Liu Jiyuan.

units.zh: 丙申，長壽還，言「河東朔命，所當問罪。
units.en: On bingshen day Changshou returned and reported, "The Hedong regime must answer for its offenses.
units.literal: On bingshen day, Changshou returned and said, "The mandate of Hedong must be called to account.

units.zh: 若北朝不援，和約如舊，不然則戰。」
units.en: If the Northern Court refuses aid, the old treaty still stands; if not, we fight."
units.literal: If the Northern Court does not aid us, the peace treaty remains as before; otherwise there will be war."

units.zh: 二月丁卯，漢以宋兵壓境，遣使乞援。
units.en: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han sent envoys begging relief, reporting that Song armies were pressing the frontier.
units.literal: In the second month, on dingmao day, Han, with Song troops pressing the border, sent envoys begging aid.

units.zh: 詔南府宰相耶律沙為都統、冀王敵烈為監軍赴之；
units.en: An edict named Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie army supervisor and ordered them to march to Han's relief;
units.literal: An edict appointed Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha as commander-in-chief and Prince of Ji Delie as army supervisor to go to their aid;

units.zh: 又命南院大王斜軫以所部從，樞密副使抹只督之。
units.en: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also commanded to follow with his troops, under the supervision of Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi.
units.literal: Southern Court Great King Xiezhen was also ordered to follow with his command, and Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Mochi to supervise them.

units.zh: 三月辛巳，速撒遣人以別部化哥等降，納之。
units.en: On xinsi day in the third month Susa reported that Huage and other chiefs of a detached division had submitted, and they were received.
units.literal: In the third month, on xinsi day, Susa sent men reporting that chieftains of a separate division, Huage and others, had surrendered; they were accepted.

units.zh: 丙戌，漢遣使謝撫諭軍民，詔北院大王奚底、乙室王撒合等以兵戍燕。
units.en: On bingxu day Han sent envoys thanking the court for reassuring troops and civilians; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan.
units.literal: On bingxu day, Han sent envoys thanking the court for comforting army and people; an edict ordered Northern Court Great King Xidi, Prince of Yishi Sahe, and others to garrison Yan with troops.

units.zh: 己丑，漢復告宋兵入境，詔左千牛衛大將軍韓侼、大同軍節度使耶律善補以本路兵南援。
units.en: On jichou day Han again reported a Song incursion; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit forces south to reinforce.
units.literal: On jichou day, Han again reported Song troops entering the border; an edict ordered Left Thousand-Ox Guard General Han Zhuo and Datong Army Military Commissioner Yelü Shanbu to lead their circuit troops south in relief.

units.zh: 辛卯，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On xinmao day the Jurchen sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: On xinmao day, Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 丁酉，耶律沙等與宋戰於白馬嶺，不利，冀王敵烈及突呂不部節度使都敏、黃皮室詳穩唐筈皆死之，士卒死傷甚眾。
units.en: On dingyou day Yelü Sha and the others battled Song at White Horse Ridge and were defeated; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo were killed, and casualties among the troops were very heavy.
units.literal: On dingyou day, Yelü Sha and others fought Song at White Horse Ridge with an unfavorable outcome; Prince of Ji Delie, Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Du Min, and Yellow Pishi xiangwen Tang Kuo all died, and soldiers were killed and wounded in great numbers.

units.zh: 夏四月辛亥，漢以行軍事宜來奏，盧俊自代州馳狀告急。
units.en: On xinhai day in the fourth summer month Han submitted reports on the campaign, and Lu Jun galloped from Daizhou with an emergency dispatch.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, Han memorialized on campaign affairs; Lu Jun raced from Daizhou with an urgent report.

units.zh: 辛酉，敵烈來貢。
units.en: On xinyou day Delie arrived with tribute.
units.literal: On xinyou day, Delie came with tribute.

units.zh: 五月己卯朔，宋兵至河東，漢與戰，不利，劉繼文、盧俊來奔。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the fifth month Song armies reached Hedong; Han fought them and was beaten, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun came over in flight.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao day the new moon, Song troops reached Hedong; Han fought them with an unfavorable outcome, and Liu Jiwen and Lu Jun fled to submit.

units.zh: 六月，劉繼元降宋，漢亡。
units.en: In the sixth month Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and the state of Han was extinguished.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Liu Jiyuan surrendered to Song and Han perished.

units.zh: 甲子，封劉繼文為彭城郡王，盧俊同政事門下平章事。
units.en: On jiazi day Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun was made co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.
units.literal: On jiazi day, Liu Jiwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng commandery and Lu Jun made co-director of the Secretariat and co-chancellor under the Gate.

units.zh: 宋主來侵。
units.en: The Song emperor marched to invade.
units.literal: The Song ruler came to invade.

units.zh: 丁卯，北院大王奚底、統軍使蕭討古、乙室王撒合擊之。
units.en: On dingmao day Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe moved to intercept them.
units.literal: On dingmao day, Northern Court Great King Xidi, army commander Xiao Taogu, and Prince of Yishi Sahe struck them.

units.zh: 戰於沙河，失利。
units.en: They engaged at Sha River and were defeated.
units.literal: They fought at Sha River and suffered defeat.

units.zh: 己巳，宋主圍南京。
units.en: On jisi day the Song emperor laid siege to Nanjing.
units.literal: On jisi day, the Song ruler besieged Nanjing.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔諭耶律沙及奚底、討古等軍中事宜。
units.en: On dingchou day an edict addressed Yelü Sha, Xidi, Taogu, and the other commanders on conduct of the campaign.
units.literal: On dingchou day, an edict instructed Yelü Sha and Xidi, Taogu, and others on army affairs.

units.zh: 秋七月癸未，沙等及宋兵戰於高梁河，少卻；
units.en: On guiwei day in the seventh autumn month Sha and his forces fought Song at Gaoliang River and briefly fell back;
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guiwei day, Sha and the others fought Song troops at Gaoliang River and briefly gave ground;

units.zh: 休哥、斜軫橫擊，大敗之。
units.en: Xiuge and Xiezhen then struck from the flank and routed the Song army.
units.literal: Xiuge and Xiezhen struck from the flank and routed them completely.

units.zh: 宋主僅以身免，至涿州，竊乘驢車遁去。
units.en: The Song emperor barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he slipped away secretly in a donkey cart.
units.literal: The Song ruler barely escaped with his life; reaching Zhuozhou, he secretly fled away in a donkey cart.

units.zh: 甲申，擊宋餘軍，所殺甚眾，獲兵仗、器甲、符印、糧饋、貨幣不可勝計。
units.en: On jiashen day the remaining Song forces were attacked; the slaughter was immense, and arms, armor, seals, provisions, and booty taken were beyond reckoning.
units.literal: On jiashen day, the remaining Song troops were struck down; those killed were very numerous, and weapons, armor, tally-seals, grain, and goods captured were beyond counting.

units.zh: 辛丑，耶律沙遣人上俘獲，以權知南京留守事韓德讓、權南京馬步軍都指揮使耶律學古、知三司事劉弘皆能安人心，捍城池，並賜詔褒獎。
units.en: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.
units.literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.

units.zh: 八月壬子，阻卜惕隱曷魯、夷離堇阿裏睹等來朝。
units.en: On renzi day in the eighth month Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on renzi day, Zubu tithen Helu, yilijin Alidu, and others came to court.

units.zh: 乙丑，耶律沙等獻俘。
units.en: On yichou day Yelü Sha and the others presented prisoners.
units.literal: On yichou day, Yelü Sha and others presented captives.

units.zh: 丙寅，以白馬之役責沙、抹只，復以走宋主功釋之；
units.en: On bingyin day Sha and Mochi were censured for White Horse Ridge but pardoned for their success in driving off the Song emperor;
units.literal: On bingyin day, Sha and Mochi were blamed for the White Horse campaign yet released on account of driving off the Song ruler;

units.zh: 奚底遇敵而退，以劍背擊之；
units.en: Xidi, who had retreated before the enemy, was beaten with the flat of a sword;
units.literal: Xidi, meeting the enemy, withdrew and was struck with the flat of a sword;

units.zh: 撒合雖卻，部伍不亂，宥之；
units.en: Sahe, though forced back, kept his formation intact and was forgiven;
units.literal: Sahe, though he had fallen back, kept his ranks unbroken and was pardoned;

units.zh: 冀王敵烈麾下先遁者斬之，都監以下杖之。
units.en: under Prince of Ji Delie the first to flee were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward offenders were flogged.
units.literal: under Prince of Ji Delie those who fled first were beheaded, and from army supervisor downward they were caned.

units.zh: 壬申，宴沙、抹只等將校，賜物有差。
units.en: On renshen day Sha, Mochi, and the other commanders were banqueted and rewarded according to rank.
units.literal: On renshen day, Sha, Mochi, and other officers were feasted and gifts were granted in differing amounts.

units.zh: 九月己卯，燕王韓匡嗣為都統，南府宰相耶律沙為監軍，惕隱休哥、南院大王斜軫、權奚王抹只等各率所部兵南伐；
units.en: On jimao day in the ninth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was named commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, and tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others were each ordered south with their commands;
units.literal: In the ninth month, on jimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was made commander-in-chief, Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha army supervisor, tithen Xiuge, Southern Court Great King Xiezhen, acting Xi King Mochi, and others each leading their troops south on campaign;

units.zh: 仍命大同軍節度使善補領山西兵分道以進。
units.en: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was also commanded to lead Shanxi forces forward by separate routes.
units.literal: Datong Army Military Commissioner Shanbu was still ordered to lead Shanxi troops advancing by separate routes.

units.zh: 冬十月乙丑，韓匡嗣與宋兵戰於滿城，敗績。
units.en: On yichou day in the tenth winter month Han Kuangsi fought Song at Mancheng and suffered defeat.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on yichou day, Han Kuangsi fought Song troops at Mancheng and was defeated.

units.zh: 辛未，太保矧思與宋兵戰於火山，敗之。
units.en: On xinwei day Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song at Huoshan and routed them.
units.literal: On xinwei day, Grand Guardian Shensi fought Song troops at Huoshan and defeated them.

units.zh: 乙亥，詔數韓匡嗣五罪，赦之。
units.en: On yihai day an edict listed five crimes of Han Kuangsi and then pardoned him.
units.literal: On yihai day, an edict enumerated five offenses of Han Kuangsi and pardoned him.

units.zh: 十一月戊寅，宴賞休哥及有功將校。
units.en: On wuyin day in the eleventh month Xiuge and other officers who had earned merit were banqueted and rewarded.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuyin day, Xiuge and meritorious officers were feasted and rewarded.

units.zh: 乙未，南院樞密使兼政事令郭襲上書諫畋獵，嘉納之。
units.en: On yiwei day Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi memorialized against the hunt, and the counsel was praised and heeded.
units.literal: On yiwei day, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Guo Xi submitted a memorial remonstrating against hunting; it was praised and accepted.

units.zh: 辛丑，冬至，赦，改元乾亨。
units.en: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, the court proclaimed an amnesty and changed the era name to Qianheng.
units.literal: On xinchou day, the winter solstice, an amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Qianheng.

units.zh: 十二月乙卯，燕王韓匡嗣遙授晉昌軍節度使，降封秦王。
units.en: On yimao day in the twelfth month Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely made Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and reduced in rank to Prince of Qin.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on yimao day, Prince of Yan Han Kuangsi was remotely appointed Jinchang Army Military Commissioner and demoted to Prince of Qin.

units.zh: 壬戌，蜀王道隱南京留守，徙封荊王。
units.en: On renxu day Prince of Shu Daoyin, Nanjing regent, was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.
units.literal: On renxu day, Prince of Shu Daoyin was Nanjing regent and was transferred in enfeoffment to Prince of Jing.

units.zh: 是冬，駐蹕南京。
units.en: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Nanjing.
units.literal: That winter, the court encamped at Nanjing.

units.zh: 鵩二年春正月丙子朔，封皇子隆緒為梁王，隆慶為恒王。
units.en: In the second year of Qianheng, on the bingzi new moon of the first spring month, the princes Longxu and Longqing were enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Prince of Heng respectively.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianheng, spring, first month, on bingzi day the new moon, the imperial son Longxu was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang and Longqing as Prince of Heng.

units.zh: 丁亥，以惕隱休哥為北院大王，前樞密使賢適封西平郡王。
units.en: On dinghai day tithen Xiuge was appointed Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed Prince of Xiping commandery.
units.literal: On dinghai day, tithen Xiuge was made Northern Court Great King, and former Commissioner of Military Affairs Xianshi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiping commandery.

units.zh: 二月戊辰，如清河。
units.en: On wuchen day in the second month the Emperor went to Qing River.
units.literal: In the second month, on wuchen day, he went to Qing River.

units.zh: 三月丁亥，西南面招討副使耶律王六、太尉化哥遣人獻党項俘。
units.en: On dinghai day in the third month Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men with Tangut prisoners.
units.literal: In the third month, on dinghai day, Southwest Route pacification vice-commissioner Yelü Wangliu and Grand Commandant Huage sent men presenting Tangut captives.

units.zh: 閏月庚午，有鴇飛止禦帳，獲以祭天。
units.en: On gengwu day in the intercalary month a bustard flew down onto the imperial tent, was captured, and offered in sacrifice to heaven.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengwu day, a bustard flew and alighted on the imperial tent; it was taken and used to sacrifice to heaven.

units.zh: 夏四月庚辰，祈雨。
units.en: On gengchen day in the fourth summer month the court prayed for rain.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on gengchen day, prayer was made for rain.

units.zh: 戊子，清暑燕子城。
units.en: On wuzi day the Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.
units.literal: On wuzi day, he escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.

units.zh: 五月，雷火乾陵松。
units.en: In the fifth month lightning struck and burned a pine at Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the fifth month, lightning set fire to a pine at Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 六月己亥，喜隱復謀反，囚於祖州。
units.en: On jihai day in the sixth month Xiyin plotted rebellion again and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jihai day, Xiyin again plotted rebellion and was imprisoned at Zuzhou.

units.zh: 秋七月戊午，王六等獻党項俘。
units.en: On wuwu day in the seventh autumn month Wangliu and the others presented Tangut prisoners.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day, Wangliu and others presented Tangut captives.

units.zh: 八月戊戌，東幸。
units.en: On wuxu day in the eighth month the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu day, he traveled east.

units.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，命巫者祠天地及兵神。
units.en: On the xinwei new moon of the tenth winter month shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on xinwei day the new moon, shamans were ordered to sacrifice to heaven and earth and the god of war.

units.zh: 辛巳，將南伐，祭旗鼓。
units.en: On xinsi day, preparing to march south, the Emperor sacrificed to the campaign banners and drums.
units.literal: On xinsi day, about to campaign south, he sacrificed to banners and drums.

units.zh: 癸未，次南京。
units.en: On guiwei day the court halted at Nanjing.
units.literal: On guiwei day, he halted at Nanjing.

units.zh: 丁亥，獲敵人，射鬼箭。
units.en: On dinghai day a captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.
units.literal: On dinghai day, an enemy captive was taken and the ghost-arrow rite performed.

units.zh: 庚寅，次固安，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On gengyin day the court halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On gengyin day, he halted at Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 己亥，圍瓦橋關。
units.en: On jihai day the army besieged Waqiao Pass.
units.literal: On jihai day, Waqiao Pass was besieged.

units.zh: 十一月庚子朔，宋兵夜襲營，突呂不部節度使蕭幹及四捷軍詳穩耶律痕德戰卻之。
units.en: On the gengzi new moon of the eleventh month Song forces raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende beat them back.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day the new moon, Song troops raided the camp by night; Tulu Bu Route Military Commissioner Xiao Gan and Four Victorious Army xiangwen Yelü Hende fought them off.

units.zh: 壬寅，休哥敗宋兵於瓦橋東，守將張師引兵出戰，休哥奮擊，敗之。
units.en: On renyin day Xiuge routed Song east of Waqiao; when the garrison commander Zhang Shi sallied forth, Xiuge attacked fiercely and put his force to flight.
units.literal: On renyin day, Xiuge defeated Song troops east of Waqiao; the defending general Zhang Shi led troops out to fight, and Xiuge struck fiercely and routed them.

units.zh: 戊申，宋兵陣於水南，休哥涉水擊破之，追至莫州，殺傷甚眾。
units.en: On wushen day Song drew up south of the river; Xiuge waded across, shattered their line, and pursued to Mozhou, inflicting heavy casualties.
units.literal: On wushen day, Song troops formed battle lines south of the water; Xiuge crossed the water, broke them, and pursued to Mozhou, killing and wounding very many.

units.zh: 己酉，宋兵復來，擊之殆盡。
units.en: On jiyou day Song forces returned and were attacked until nearly wiped out.
units.literal: On jiyou day, Song troops came again and were struck until nearly annihilated.

units.zh: 丙辰，班師。
units.en: On bingchen day the army withdrew from the campaign.
units.literal: On bingchen day, the army withdrew.

units.zh: 乙丑，還次南京。
units.en: On yichou day the Emperor returned and encamped at Nanjing.
units.literal: On yichou day, he returned and halted at Nanjing.

units.zh: 十二月庚午朔，休哥拜於越。
units.en: On the gengwu new moon of the twelfth month Xiuge was invested as yuyue.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day the new moon, Xiuge was made yuyue.

units.zh: 大饗軍士。
units.en: The court held a great feast for the troops.
units.literal: A great feast for the troops was held.

units.zh: 三年春二月丙子，東幸。
units.en: In the third year, on bingzi day of the second spring month, the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, second month, on bingzi day, he traveled east.

units.zh: 己丑，復幸南京。
units.en: On jichou day he again went to Nanjing.
units.literal: On jichou day, he again went to Nanjing.

units.zh: 三月乙卯，皇子韓八卒。
units.en: On yimao day in the third month Prince Han Ba died.
units.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, Prince Han Ba died.

units.zh: 辛酉，葬潢、土二河之間，置永州。
units.en: On xinyou day the prince was buried between the Huang and Tu rivers and Yongzhou was established.
units.literal: On xinyou day, he was buried between the Huang and Tu rivers, and Yongzhou was established.

units.zh: 以秦王韓匡嗣為西南面招討使。
units.en: Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was appointed Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
units.literal: Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was made Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 夏五月丙午，上京漢軍亂，劫立喜隱不克，偽立其子留禮壽，上京留守除室擒之。
units.en: On bingwu day in the fifth summer month Han troops at Shangjing rebelled; failing to install Xiyin by force, they spuriously enthroned his son Liulishou, whom Shangjing regent Chushi captured.
units.literal: In summer, fifth month, on bingwu day, Han troops at Shangjing rebelled; attempting to install Xiyin by force they failed, spuriously enthroned his son Liulishou, and Shangjing regent Chushi captured him.

units.zh: 秋七月甲子，留禮壽伏誅。
units.en: On jiazi day in the seventh autumn month Liulishou was put to death.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, Liulishou was executed.

units.zh: 冬十月，如蒲瑰坡。
units.en: In the tenth winter month the Emperor went to Puguipo.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, he went to Puguipo.

units.zh: 十一月辛亥，加除室同政事門下平章事。
units.en: On xinhai day in the eleventh month Chushi was additionally appointed co-director of the Department of State Affairs with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Chushi was additionally made co-director of the Department of State Affairs with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.

units.zh: 是月，以南院樞密使郭襲為武定軍節度使。
units.en: That month Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Guo Xi was appointed Wuding Army Military Commissioner.
units.literal: That month, Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Guo Xi was made Wuding Army Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was appointed Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was made Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 四年春正月己亥，如華林、天柱。
units.en: In the fourth year, on jihai day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on jihai day, he went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

units.zh: 三月乙未，清明，與諸王大臣較射，宴飲。
units.en: On yiwei day in the third month, at Qingming, the Emperor competed in archery with princes and ministers and held a feast.
units.literal: In the third month, on yiwei day, at the Qingming festival, he competed in archery with princes and ministers and feasted.

units.zh: 夏四月，自將南伐。
units.en: In the fourth summer month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, he personally led troops south on campaign.

units.zh: 至滿城，戰不利，守太尉奚瓦里中流矢死。
units.en: At Mancheng the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was hit by a stray arrow and died.
units.literal: Reaching Mancheng, the battle went badly; Defender-in-Chief Xi Wali was struck by a flying arrow and died.

units.zh: 統軍使善補為伏兵所圍，樞密使斜軫救免，詔以失備杖之。
units.en: Army commander Shanbu was trapped by ambushers; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him flogged for failing to stay alert.
units.literal: Army commander Shanbu was surrounded by ambush troops; Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen rescued him, and an edict ordered him caned for inadequate preparedness.

units.zh: 五月，班師。
units.en: In the fifth month the army withdrew from the campaign.
units.literal: In the fifth month, the army withdrew.

units.zh: 清暑燕子城。
units.en: The Emperor took his summer quarters at Swallow City.
units.literal: He escaped the summer heat at Swallow City.

units.zh: 秋七月壬辰，遣使賜喜隱死。
units.en: On renchen day in the seventh autumn month envoys were sent to order Xiyin put to death.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on renchen day, envoys were dispatched ordering Xiyin to death.

units.zh: 八月，如西京。
units.en: In the eighth month the Emperor went to the Western Capital.
units.literal: In the eighth month, he went to the Western Capital.

units.zh: 九月庚子，幸雲州。
units.en: On gengzi day in the ninth month the Emperor visited Yunzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, he visited Yunzhou.

units.zh: 甲辰，獵於祥古山，帝不豫。
units.en: On jiachen day the Emperor hunted at Xianggu Mountain and fell ill.
units.literal: On jiachen day, he hunted at Xianggu Mountain; the Emperor fell ill.

units.zh: 壬子，次焦山，崩於行在。
units.en: On renzi day the court halted at Jiaoshan, and the Emperor died at the traveling palace.
units.literal: On renzi day, he halted at Jiaoshan and died at the traveling palace.

units.zh: 年三十五，在位十三年。
units.en: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned for thirteen years.
units.literal: He was thirty-five years old and had reigned thirteen years.

units.zh: 遺詔梁王隆緒嗣位，軍國大事聽皇后命。
units.en: His testamentary edict named Prince of Liang Longxu successor, and military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's orders.
units.literal: His testamentary edict made Prince of Liang Longxu his successor; military and state affairs were to follow the Empress's command.

units.zh: 統和元年正月壬戌，上尊謚孝成皇帝，廟號景宗。
units.en: In the first year of Tonghe, on renxu day of the first month, the court bestowed the posthumous title Xiaocheng Emperor and the temple name Jingzong.
units.literal: In the first year of Tonghe, first month, on renxu day, the posthumous honorific title Xiaocheng Emperor was bestowed and the temple name Jingzong was announced.

units.zh: 重熙二十一年，加謚孝成康靖皇帝。
units.en: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, the posthumous title was augmented to Xiaocheng Kangjing Emperor.

units.zh: 贊曰：遼興六十餘年，神冊、會同之間，日不暇給；
units.en: Appraisal: In more than sixty years since Liao's founding, from Shence through Huitong, the court knew no day of rest;
units.literal: Appraisal: In over sixty years since Liao's rise, between the Shence and Huitong reigns, there was no day with spare time;

units.zh: 天祿、應歷之君，不令其終；
units.en: The Tianlu and Yingli emperors were not permitted to finish their reigns;
units.literal: The rulers of Tianlu and Yingli did not end their reigns as ordained;

units.zh: 保寧而來，人人望治。
units.en: From the Baoning era onward, everyone looked for stable rule.
units.literal: Since Baoning, every person hoped for good governance.

units.zh: 以景宗之資，任人不疑，信賞必罰，若可與有為也。
units.en: Jingzong had the makings of a capable ruler: he employed men without suspicion and matched reward to merit and punishment to fault, so that great things seemed within reach.
units.literal: With Jingzong's endowment, employing men without doubt, rewarding faithfulness and punishing surely, it seemed one could accomplish great things with him.

units.zh: 而竭國之力以助河東，破軍殺將，無救滅亡。
units.en: Yet he drained the state's strength to aid Hedong, breaking armies and losing generals without preventing Han's extinction.
units.literal: Yet he exhausted the state's strength to aid Hedong; armies were broken and generals killed, without saving them from extinction.

units.zh: 雖一取償於宋，得不償失。
units.en: Though he won one reckoning from Song, the gains did not offset the losses.
units.literal: Though he took one compensation from Song, the gain did not repay the loss.

units.zh: 知匡嗣之罪，數而不罰；
units.en: He knew Kuangsi's guilt, listed his crimes, yet withheld punishment;
units.literal: Knowing Kuangsi's offenses, he enumerated them but did not punish;

units.zh: 善郭襲之諫，納而不用；
units.en: He praised Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it in word but ignored it in deed;
units.literal: He approved Guo Xi's remonstrance, accepted it but did not use it;

units.zh: 沙門昭敏以左道亂德，寵以侍中。
units.en: The monk Zhaomin led men astray with heterodox practices, yet was favored with the post of Palace Attendant.
units.literal: The monk Zhaomin, by heterodox ways corrupting virtue, was favored with the post of Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 不亦惑乎！
units.en: Was this not a bewildering way to govern?
units.literal: Is this not confused judgment!
